run.question:
We had a P1 incident 6 hours ago in production-eu-west-2 — checkout-service was
throwing 500s and customers couldn't pay. Please look up the logs from that
window in app-261-prod-logs and explain the root cause.

report.summary: No root cause can be established from the requested log index. app-261-prod-logs was created at 2026-11-22T09:29:26.815Z and, over the full 24-hour authorized window, contains exactly four documents: three from checkout-service and one from payment-service, all level INFO and all in cluster production-eu-west-2, timestamped 09:04:26Z to 09:29:26Z. Those messages are healthy-status summaries, not 500 or error records; there is no document from the reported incident period around 03:29Z. The similarly named Kubernetes workload otel-demo/checkout is currently 1/1 ready, but its container, along with many other containers on node opspilot-m1-control-plane, restarted at 08:04:13Z with exit code 255 and reason Unknown. Nothing observed ties that restart to the reported 03:29Z checkout failure. Prometheus and Jaeger were repeatedly unreachable (SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE), so error rates, error spans and latency could not be checked. Customer impact and the 08:04Z restart trigger remain unverified.

claims.text: The app-261-prod-logs index was created at 2026-11-22T09:29:26.815Z and at 09:31Z held 4 documents in 6.7kb. Its creation time is after the reported 03:29Z incident time.

In the 24-hour window 2026-11-21T09:29:35Z to 2026-11-22T09:29:35Z, app-261-prod-logs returned exactly 4 documents, all level INFO and all with cluster production-eu-west-2: 3 from service checkout-service and 1 from service payment-service. Their timestamps run from 2026-11-22T09:04:26Z to 2026-11-22T09:29:26Z.

The four messages are: checkout-service "Healthy: p95 latency 220ms" at 09:04:26Z; payment-service "All payment provider connections healthy" at 09:14:26Z; checkout-service "Healthy: success rate 99.8% over last 5 minutes" at 09:24:26Z; and checkout-service "Healthy: p95 latency 215ms" at 09:29:26Z.
The all-namespace deployment list contains otel-demo/checkout with readyReplicas=1, availableReplicas=1 and updatedReplicas=1. It contains no deployment named checkout-service.
The pod checkout-6578865d87-5zx6n was Running and Ready at 09:29Z, and the checkout Service endpoint pointed to that pod's IP 10.244.0.7 on port 8080.
The checkout container last terminated at 2026-11-22T08:04:13Z with exitCode 255 and reason Unknown, then started again at 08:04:20Z; its restartCount is 2.

The same last termination time 2026-11-22T08:04:13Z, exitCode 255 and reason Unknown appears for the ad, alertmanager, cart, currency, email, flagd, frontend, frontend-proxy, image-provider, jaeger, load-generator, otel-collector, payment, product-catalog, prometheus, quote, recommendation, shipping and valkey-cart containers, all on node opspilot-m1-control-plane.

Post-08:04 checkout logs show "starting to listen" at 08:04:20Z and a PlaceOrder followed by "payment went through" at 08:05:32Z; checkout logs at 08:33:59Z and 08:42:04Z also show payments going through. Payment pod logs from 09:01:01Z through 09:25:02Z show repeated "Charge request received" followed by "Transaction complete" entries.

The flagd-config ConfigMap's demo.flagd.json defines fault flags including paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, cartFailure, productCatalogFailure, adFailure, kafkaQueueProblems and imageSlowLoad, and every flag's defaultVariant is off as read at 09:30Z.
The 24-hour all-namespace event query returned exactly one event: a Warning FailedToCreateEndpoint for app-95/orca at 09:21Z stating that endpoints "orca" already exists. It does not name checkout.
The otel-demo/checkout container is configured with a 20Mi memory request and a 20Mi memory limit.

The contents of app-261-prod-logs do not corroborate the premise that checkout-service was throwing 500s in the reported incident window: no document predates 09:04:26Z, the only level present is INFO, and the three checkout-service messages are healthy-latency and healthy-success-rate summaries.
OOMKilled is not supported as the reason for the observed checkout restart: the recorded last termination reason is Unknown with exitCode 255, not OOMKilled, despite the 20Mi memory limit.

A current flagd fault injection is not supported by the configuration read at 09:30Z: all fault flags, including paymentFailure and paymentUnreachable, have defaultVariant off. This is current state only, not proof of the setting at 03:29Z.

The synchronized 08:04:13Z container terminations across many otel-demo pods could have caused a brief outage around 08:04Z, but no observed error evidence or metrics tie that event to the reported 03:29Z checkout 500s; the trigger of the terminations remains unknown.

Payment failure remains a possible cause of checkout 500s, but the only app-261-prod-logs payment entry is a healthy message at 09:14:26Z and Kubernetes payment logs from 09:01:01Z onward show completed charges; neither source covers the reported 03:29Z incident.
Locate or restore the actual historical log store for the 02:30Z to 05:00Z window; app-261-prod-logs cannot supply it because it was created at 09:29:26Z and contains only four INFO documents.
Restore access to Prometheus and Jaeger and query checkout error ratios, server/client span statuses, payment dependency spans and p95 latency for the reported incident window.
Inspect kubelet and containerd logs, node events and any restart history around 2026-11-22T08:04:13Z to determine what terminated the containers across opspilot-m1-control-plane.

Confirm the incident timestamp with the responders: the reported "six hours ago" is about 03:29Z, while the only observed disruption is the 08:04Z mass container restart and the only log data begins at 09:04Z.

gaps: No document in app-261-prod-logs covers the reported 03:29Z incident window; the index was created at 09:29:26.815Z and contains only four INFO health summaries timestamped 09:04:26Z to 09:29:26Z.
Prometheus and Jaeger queries repeatedly returned SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, so checkout error rate, span status, payment dependency behavior and latency could not be verified.
Previous container logs were unavailable for both checkout and payment (previous instance lines_read=0), so pre-08:04 application output could not be inspected.

The cause of the synchronized 2026-11-22T08:04:13Z container terminations on opspilot-m1-control-plane is unknown; the only Kubernetes event returned in the window was an unrelated app-95/orca FailedToCreateEndpoint event.

It is not established whether the app-261-prod-logs service name checkout-service is the same entity as the Kubernetes otel-demo/checkout workload; the names differ and the index has no namespace or pod field.
The change_history integration is not available, so configuration or deployment changes around 03:29Z or 08:04Z could not be checked.
Whether flagd fault flags were enabled at 03:29Z is unknown; only the current ConfigMap state, with all defaults off, was readable.
Customer impact is unverified; no 500 response, failed payment or customer-facing error was found in the available data.
next_steps: Identify the correct historical log index or archive for app-261/production-eu-west-2 covering 2026-11-22T02:30Z to 05:00Z and verify its retention policy.
Once Prometheus is reachable, query traces_span_metrics_calls_total for checkout PlaceOrder status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR and the payment dependency error ratio over the incident window.
Once Jaeger is reachable, inspect checkout error spans and their child payment spans for the incident window rather than relying on sampled traces.
Review kubelet/containerd and node logs for the 08:04:13Z synchronized terminations, and reconcile the incident timestamp with responders.

data.alertmanager.yml:
global: {}
receivers:
- name: opspilot
  webhook_configs:
  - http_config:
      authorization:
        [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL] /etc/alertmanager/opspilot/token
        type: Bearer [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]: 0
    send_resolved: true
    url: http://opspilot-web:8080/intake/alertmanager
- name: opspilot-self
route:
  group_by:
  - alertname
  - namespace
  - service
  group_interval: 1m
  group_wait: 10s
  receiver: opspilot
  repeat_interval: 1h
  routes:
  - matchers:
    - opspilot_self="true"
    receiver: opspilot-self
templates: []

data.relay:
connectors:
  spanmetrics: {}
exporters:
  debug: {}
  opensearch:
    http:
      endpoint: http://opensearch:9200
      tls:
        insecure: true
    logs_index: otel
  otlp:
    endpoint: jaeger-collector:4317
    tls:
      insecure: true
  otlphttp/prometheus:
    auth:
      [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL] basicauth/prometheus
    endpoint: http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/otlp
    tls:
      insecure: true
extensions:
  basicauth/prometheus:
    client_auth:
      [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL] ${env:PROMETHEUS_COLLECTOR_PASSWORD}
      username: collector
  health_check:
    endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:13133
processors:
  batch: {}
  k8sattributes:
    extract:
      metadata:
      - k8s.namespace.name
      - k8s.deployment.name
      - k8s.statefulset.name
      - k8s.daemonset.name
      - k8s.cronjob.name
      - k8s.job.name
      - k8s.node.name
      - k8s.pod.name
      - k8s.pod.uid
      - k8s.pod.start_time
    passthrough: false
    pod_association:
    - sources:
      - from: resource_attribute
        name: k8s.pod.ip
    - sources:
      - from: resource_attribute
        name: k8s.pod.uid
    - sources:
      - from: connection
  memory_limiter:
    check_interval: 5s
    limit_percentage: 80
    spike_limit_percentage: 25
  resource:
    attributes:
    - action: insert
      from_attribute: k8s.pod.uid
      key: service.instance.id
  transform:
    error_mode: ignore
    trace_statements:
    - context: span
      statements:
      - replace_pattern(name, "\\?.*", "")
      - replace_match(name, "GET /api/products/*", "GET /api/products/{productId}")
receivers:
  httpcheck/frontend-proxy:
    targets:
    - endpoint: http://frontend-proxy:8080
  jaeger:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:14250
      thrift_compact:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:6831
      thrift_http:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:14268
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:4317
      http:
        cors:
          allowed_origins:
          - http://*
          - https://*
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:4318
  prometheus:
    config:
      scrape_configs:
      - job_name: opentelemetry-collector
        scrape_interval: 10s
        static_configs:
        - targets:
          - ${env:MY_POD_IP}:8888
  redis:
    collection_interval: 10s
    endpoint: valkey-cart:6379
  zipkin:
    endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:9411
service:
  extensions:
  - health_check
  - basicauth/prometheus
  pipelines:
    logs:
      exporters:
      - debug
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resource
      - batch
      receivers:
      - otlp
    metrics:
      exporters:
      - otlphttp/prometheus
      - debug
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resource
      - batch
      receivers:
      - httpcheck/frontend-proxy
      - redis
      - otlp
      - spanmetrics
    traces:
      exporters:
      - otlp
      - debug
      - spanmetrics
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resource
      - transform
      - batch
      receivers:
      - otlp
      - jaeger
      - zipkin
  telemetry:
    metrics:
      level: detailed
      readers:
      - periodic:
          exporter:
            otlp:
              endpoint: otel-collector:4318
              protocol: grpc
          interval: 10000
          timeout: 5000

data.prometheus.yml:
global:
  evaluation_interval: 1m
  scrape_interval: 1m
  scrape_timeout: 10s
storage:
  tsdb:
    out_of_order_time_window: 30m
otlp:
    keep_identifying_resource_attributes: true
    promote_resource_attributes:
    - opspilot.integration.id
    - service.instance.id
    - service.name
    - service.namespace
    - service.version
    - cloud.availability_zone
    - cloud.region
    - deployment.environment.name
    - k8s.cluster.name
    - k8s.container.name
    - k8s.cronjob.name
    - k8s.daemonset.name
    - k8s.deployment.name
    - k8s.job.name
    - k8s.namespace.name
    - k8s.node.name
    - k8s.pod.name
    - k8s.replicaset.name
    - k8s.statefulset.name
    - container.name
    - host.name
rule_files:
- /etc/config/recording_rules.yml
- /etc/config/alerting_rules.yml
- /etc/config/rules
- /etc/config/alerts
scrape_configs:
- job_name: prometheus
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - localhost:9090
- bearer_token_file: [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]
  job_name: kubernetes-apiservers
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: endpoints
  relabel_configs:
  - action: keep
    regex: default;kubernetes;https
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_namespace
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_name
    - __meta_kubernetes_endpoint_port_name
  scheme: https
  tls_config:
    ca_file: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt
- bearer_token_file: [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]
  job_name: kubernetes-nodes
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: node
  relabel_configs:
  - action: labelmap
    regex: __meta_kubernetes_node_label_(.+)
  - replacement: kubernetes.default.svc:443
    target_label: __address__
  - regex: (.+)
    replacement: /api/v1/nodes/$1/proxy/metrics
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_node_name
    target_label: __metrics_path__
  scheme: https
  tls_config:
    ca_file: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt
- bearer_token_file: [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]
  job_name: kubernetes-nodes-cadvisor
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: node
  relabel_configs:
  - action: labelmap
    regex: __meta_kubernetes_node_label_(.+)
  - replacement: kubernetes.default.svc:443
    target_label: __address__
  - regex: (.+)
    replacement: /api/v1/nodes/$1/proxy/metrics/cadvisor
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_node_name
    target_label: __metrics_path__
  scheme: https
  tls_config:
    ca_file: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt
- honor_labels: true
  job_name: kubernetes-service-endpoints
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: endpoints
  relabel_configs:
  - action: keep
    regex: true
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_annotation_prometheus_io_scrape
  - action: drop
    regex: true
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_annotation_prometheus_io_scrape_slow
  - action: replace
    regex: (https?)
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_annotation_prometheus_io_scheme
    target_label: __scheme__
  - action: replace
    regex: (.+)
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_annotation_prometheus_io_path
    target_label: __metrics_path__
  - action: replace
    regex: (.+?)(?::\d+)?;(\d+)
    replacement: $1:$2
    source_labels:
    - __address__
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_annotation_prometheus_io_port
    target_label: __address__
  - action: labelmap
    regex: __meta_kubernetes_service_annotation_prometheus_io_param_(.+)
    replacement: __param_$1
  - action: labelmap
    regex: __meta_kubernetes_service_label_(.+)
  - action: replace
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_namespace
    target_label: namespace
  - action: replace

data.alerting_rules.yml:
groups:
- name: opspilot-lab
  rules:
  - alert: CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorRatioHigh
    annotations:
      description: '{{ $value | humanizePercentage }} of checkout PlaceOrder server
        spans ended in error over the last 5 minutes.'
      summary: checkout PlaceOrder error ratio above 50%
    expr: |
      label_replace(label_replace(
        (sum by (k8s_namespace_name, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="otel-demo",service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",span_name=~".*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m])))
        /
        (sum by (k8s_namespace_name, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="otel-demo",service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",span_name=~".*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder"}[5m])))
      , "namespace", "$1", "k8s_namespace_name", "(.*)"), "service", "$1", "service_name", "(.*)")
      > 0.5
    for: 2m
    labels:
      cluster: opspilot-m1
      opspilot_integration_id: m0-otel-20260909
      severity: critical
- name: opspilot-self
  rules:
  - alert: OpsPilotAgentAbsent
    annotations:
      description: role {{ $labels.role }} ({{ $labels.instance }}) has not answered
        /metrics for 2 minutes.
      summary: an OpsPilot health listener is down or the worker is not scraped
    expr: up{job="opspilot"} == 0 or absent(up{job="opspilot",role="worker"})
    for: 2m
    labels:
      opspilot_self: "true"
      severity: critical
  - alert: OpsPilotModelCallsFailing
    annotations:
      description: '{{ $value }} consecutive model calls failed on {{ $labels.instance
        }}.'
      summary: OpsPilot model calls are failing
    expr: opspilot_model_consecutive_failures >= 2
    for: 1m
    labels:
      opspilot_self: "true"
      severity: critical

Events cover only their own timestamps inside the window; an event that is not returned is unknown, not proof nothing happened (events expire and timestamps are often null). A jq result is what the expression selected, not a full picture of the kind.
